name: Storm Relay Shards

rarity.note: Echo of the largest working ever performed; fragments only.

summary: Fragments of the nineteen Relay Stones where nine hundred weavers stood to chain the hurricanes. Broken by weather and pilgrim-hammers over fourteen centuries, the shards still remember their word — hold, begin, or the illegible last one. A shard held in rising wind whispers its stone's word against the palm. Sailors pay for 'hold' shards; nobody pays for the other kind.
origin: ~700 CoW — the Bound Storms' chaining relay; stones broken gradually since
current_whereabouts: Scattered across southern coasts; the Storm-Bound collect them when found.
properties: 'Hold' shards: whisper their word in wind; prized as storm-warning
'Begin' shards: whisper once a season, always on the same day — the day the chaining started
The illegible word's shard (only one known): whispers nothing, but dogs refuse to ride in the same boat
keepers: Storm-Bound tide-moots pool found shards; the Mooring Deep's chart marks where each was found.
value_or_danger: Twenty crowns for 'hold'. The last stone's shard: not for sale at any price yet offered.
adventure_hooks: A 'begin' shard starts whispering daily instead of yearly. The arithmetic of that is very bad.
Players find the second illegible-word shard. The two, placed together, complete a word.
